key_insight: Eigenius separates computational equality from propositional proof irrelevance so verified scientific knowledge can retain distinct derivations and their provenance.
engineering_relevance: Preserving derivation provenance can support evidence comparison and dependency-aware retraction when assays, reagents, or models are invalidated.
method: Define a dependent type kernel with rewrite-based equality and explicitly witnessed proof irrelevance.
Unify universe, function, and ontology subtyping through coercion-free subsumption.
Integrate external verifiers, explicit axiom policies, provenance tracking, and record-typed open-world knowledge graphs.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistency, subject reduction, typing soundness and completeness, and Lean 4 mechanization with zero sorry axioms, but no empirical benchmarks.
watch_item: Scalability and practical integration with scientific data pipelines and external verifiers remain unestablished by the abstract.
paper_title: Typed Knowledge over Constructive Institutions: A Proof-Relevant Type Theory for Verified Science
